verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee accepts natural-language input only inside specific features: `ai_query` and `ai_extract_rules` let users describe what data to extract in plain language. An official MCP server lets an AI client drive the product, which allows indirect natural-language operation. Otherwise the product is run through structured API parameters, JSON JS-scenario instructions and CLI subcommands. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface for running the product end to end (crawls, scenarios, configuration), documentation of how the MCP server maps natural-language requests to actions, and hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.
